fixedAnchors.name: Exposed upper-right outer knee-pad edge
fixedAnchors.method: Rightmost qualifying pixel in the exposed right pad ROI, then first qualifying y at that x. Actual pad boundary, not a canvas coordinate.

fixedAnchors.name: Midpoint of exposed frontmost lower rounded knee-pad edge plateau
fixedAnchors.method: Lowest qualifying pad row in exposed front pad ROI; midpoint of its qualifying x range. The rounded front corner has a real visible plateau, so a half-pixel midpoint is retained without rounding.

sensitivity.interpretation: Threshold40/45/50 gives the same y863 and front midpoint within1px across all sources and sampled thresholds. Thresholds20-35 can capture floor/shadow; those points are rejected as pad features.

invariantDimensions.name: Projected full visible pad horizontal extent
invariantDimensions.method: Rightmost exposed pad x minus leftmost exposed pad x, common neutral threshold40. Measures actual pad footprint extent.
invariantDimensions.caveat: Leftmost y is unstable on a rounded antialiased edge and is not selected as a fixed anchor.

invariantDimensions.name: Projected exposed bright-neutral tyre vertical contour span
invariantDimensions.method: At least10 consecutive neutral tyre pixels in each qualifying row, common brightness threshold30, outer top/bottom exposed tyre ROIs. Run filter excludes isolated human-outline anti-alias pixels.

sensitivity.interpretation: 193px at threshold30 across all3; threshold35 yields192/193/193px, within1%. Threshold40 erodes the dark lower tyre rim and is unsuitable for this contour.

invariantDimensions.caveat: This is a consistently defined visible raster tyre contour. It is not a true3D radius, unoccluded geometric diameter, axle length or calibrated grip-width claim.

measurementMethods.scope: Visible projected raster features, not calibrated3D dimensions.
